title: Idle Grounds: plan
source: Source of truth: docs/Design/plan.json, edited with tools/plan/set-task.cjs.

task.in-progress: In progress: someone (an agent) is working on it now; the "now" line says who.
task.next: Next: the next thing to start.
task.todo: To do: planned and can start.
task.blocked: Blocked: cannot start; needs art, an owner answer or another task (the reason is shown).
task.waiting: Waiting: could start, but not a good time yet (the reason is shown).

milestone.done: Done: every task is done and the exit criteria hold.
milestone.in-progress: In progress: work on it is running now.
milestone.next: Next: starts as soon as the current milestone allows.
milestone.later: Later: planned for after the current ones.
milestone.waiting: Waiting: held back on purpose until something else lands.
milestone.blocked: Blocked: everything left needs an outside answer or delivery.

owners.Artist: ChatGPT via the shared Drive folder: delivers art from the art specification.

milestones.name: Unity port of the browser game
milestones.goal: Bring the whole browser prototype into Unity: every system and screen, with the world rebuilt as floating Islands joined by one-way Spirit Bridges and no offline progress.
milestones.exit: The Unity game plays like the browser version (parity audits passed) and the Island and Bridge rules of ADR 0002 and 0003 are in.

tasks.title: Port every system and screen from the HTML game
tasks.detail: The full game runs in Unity with scenes, prefabs and data assets; parity audits passed.

tasks.title: Floating islands, Spirit Bridges, no offline progress
tasks.detail: Regions became floating Islands linked by one-way bridges (ADR 0002, 0003).

milestones.name: Balance and onboarding
milestones.goal: Make the first run take about 2 to 3 hours, with machines overtaking hand work in the mid game, and teach the island and bridge ideas through quests.
milestones.exit: The playthrough bot confirms the pacing (ADR 0004) and the quests walk a new player through bridges, caravans and cross-island trade.

tasks.title: Real balance: 2-3 h first run, machines beat hands mid-game
tasks.detail: TEST mode off by default; playthrough bot checks the pacing (ADR 0004).

tasks.title: Island onboarding quests
tasks.detail: Quests that teach bridges, caravans and cross-island trade, with next-step hints.

tasks.title: Rebalance after the empty start
tasks.detail: With no starter buildings, machines out-produce hands only 3.8x mid-run (target 5-10x, ADR 0004); ending at 2:33 is still in the 2-3 h band.

milestones.name: Island requesters replace ascension (ADR 0007, accepted)
milestones.goal: Replace ascension with optional Island requesters: eleven Islands unlocked in a fixed order by tributes at the Sky-Bridge Shrine, one NPC per Island with three optional requests each, and the Heavenly Gate as the ending (ADR 0007).
milestones.exit: The game has 11 Islands, the Shrine, 11 NPCs with 33 requests, no ascension, vows or perks, and the playthrough bot finishes in about 3 hours both with and without taking requests.

tasks.title: Island requesters design (ADR 0007)
tasks.detail: Accepted 2026-10-12: 11 islands in a fixed order unlocked by tributes at the north Sky-Bridge Shrine; 11 NPCs (one per island) with 3 optional requests each; Heavenly Gate ending.

tasks.title: Phase 1: remove ascension, perks, vows, offerings; Heavenly Gate ending; save migration
tasks.detail: Done 2026-10-12: ascension, Ascension Points, perks, vows, offerings and the run reset removed; Heavenly Gate on Celestial is the ending (free play continues); old saves migrate (perks become bonuses where a requester replaces them). Playthrough bot: 2:12 human pace to the ending.

tasks.title: Phase 2: Sky-Bridge Shrine, fixed unlock order, Celestial moves north, Sky Paths
tasks.detail: Replaces the unlock steles; quests retargeted to the new order.

tasks.title: Phase 3: requester NPCs on the 7 existing islands (21 requests)
tasks.detail: Request panel, right-click feeding, rewards: new buildings and automation utilities.

tasks.title: Phase 4: 4 new islands (Lotus Marsh, Thunder Crag, Azure Beast Ravine, Tribulation Peak) + their NPCs
tasks.detail: Nodes, Azure Wolf, 9 buildings, 12 items, 4 NPCs; placeholder art until delivered.
tasks.blockedBy: After phase 3 and the Game.unity split (M5)

tasks.title: Phase 5: balance to a ~3 h ending
tasks.detail: Playthrough bot: greedy run 2:30-3:30, no-requests run under 4:15.

tasks.title: Art for the shrine, NPCs and 4 new islands (ART-SPEC §3.7, 144 files)
tasks.detail: P1 shrine + 7 NPC sprites first, then the new island tilesets, buildings and items.
tasks.blockedBy: Artist: 64 px batch 2R (6 NPC idle strips, Creatures-64-002: keep frame 0, redraw frames 1-3) and batch 1R2 (4 building loops, Buildings-64-004) requested 2026-10-25; Lin NPC idle @64 accepted as a file. Still open from the 2026-10-21 review (art38): sky path, new-island tilesets, floating-base buildings, 6 portraits. 74 validated files + Shrine @64 + Lin wait on ADR 0007 Phase 2 code for the in-game check

tasks.title: Fix the flaky PlayMode test Logistics_WispLaunches_ConverterCompletes
tasks.detail: The first converter batch takes 20.5 s of game time but the test waits only 18 s; it fails before and after phase 1.

milestones.name: 3/4 world look (ADR 0005)
milestones.goal: Give every Island the agreed 3/4 look: cliff walls, side faces, hanging undersides and natural coastlines (ADR 0005).
milestones.exit: All Islands show the new walls, undersides and smooth coasts without seams or stripes, and the owner has seen the result.

tasks.title: South cliff walls, side faces, grass lips
tasks.detail: Islands show a 3-tile cliff on the south edge and a narrow earth face on the west/east edges, so they read as floating rock seen from above.
tasks.now: art loop: integrating deliveries as they arrive

tasks.title: Integrate vertical side walls (v2, with variants)
tasks.detail: Swap the rotated first version for the artist's corrected vertical side faces.

tasks.title: Integrate the new hanging undersides (3/4 rock, roots, vines)
tasks.detail: Replace the side-view rocks under the south cliffs with the redrawn 3/4 pieces.

tasks.title: Fishing ground patches (3rd version)
tasks.detail: Calm cool-grey shingle patches for the Fishing island; earlier two were rejected.
tasks.blockedBy: Integrated; nearly invisible in game; repair requested from the artist

tasks.title: Rebuild the sky with the kept background islands
tasks.detail: Background islands now load from their own folder so new deliveries can't replace them.

tasks.title: Cliff wall seam and stripe fix
tasks.detail: The artist's cliff tiles still have transparent seams and a light-to-dark stripe per tile; patched in code for now.
tasks.blockedBy: Waiting for the artist's corrected cliff walls (ART-SPEC delivery log)

tasks.title: Smooth stepped and long-straight coasts
tasks.detail: Signed off 2026-10-12: curved coastlines with walls, lips and side faces following the curve.

tasks.title: Designer team visual pass: find and fix what makes the game look off
tasks.detail: 4 reviews done (docs/reviews/2026-10-13-*); merged plan docs/reviews/2026-10-13-visual-pass-plan.md: Batch A 27 fixes (no input), Batch B 9 (your answers), Batch C 77 new art files.
tasks.now: Batch A done; waiting for your answers (batch B) and sending the art request (batch C)

tasks.title: Visual pass batch A1: UI fixes (buttons, wording, dialogs, scrim, tree, menus)
tasks.detail: VP-01..05, 08, 09, 18, 21-26: stale ascension wording, overflowing confirm button, playtime, Debug button, dim behind dialogs, hand chip overlap, recipe names, Altar tree fit and states, build menu, bars and docks, dialog text.

tasks.title: Visual pass batch A2: world labels and overlays
tasks.detail: VP-06, 07, 10, 13, 15, 19, 20: readable plated world labels, Heavenly Gate captions, converter strips by zoom, pixel-line overlays, decor vs interactable, hover tags, placement/demolish feedback.

tasks.title: Visual pass batch A3: world art in code (veil, ground, cliffs, paths, rack/bridge)
tasks.detail: VP-11, 12, 14, 16, 17: veil seams + coast leak, interim rack and bridge backings, seeded ground variety, cliff/underside/lip noise, rounded paths/plaza/islets.

tasks.title: Visual pass batch B: changes that need your answers
tasks.detail: Owner answered 2026-10-21 (owner-picks-2026-10-21-visual.json): panels anchored on the building, guidance text-only, Pixelify Sans + icons for ALL UI (consistent), icon-only bar with tooltips and Reset in a menu, zoom: 4 crisp steps + far map step at 120 cells, calmer darker ground on every island.

tasks.title: Visual pass batch C: new art (77 files)
tasks.detail: Ground fills, macro patches, veil mist v2, shadows, rack/bridge, icons, item drops; 45 files can start now, 32 wait on your answers.
tasks.blockedBy: Art request goes to Drive with the batch A results; the round cliff walls of C1 arrived early (Islands-040) and were rejected in Play on 2026-10-21

tasks.title: Follow-ups from batch A
tasks.detail: Veil shows faint vertical banding beyond the max zoom; converter strips can sit on the building above in dense clusters; real-mouse checks of hover tags and the hand chip (VP-27).

tasks.title: Building art redo: reference sheet for all 26 buildings
tasks.detail: Owner signed off the 64 px pilot 2026-10-24 (rollout). First batch: pilot fixes (Workbench front view + loop, Kiln idle mouth + smoke, Paper Mill base + fuller loop) and B1 Sky-Bridge Shrine; then NPCs, other buildings, nodes, trees/props, creatures.
tasks.now: 64 px batch 1R (64-003) reviewed: Workbench loop interim (repair), Kiln/Paper Mill loops + Shrine glow rejected; batch 1R2 (64-004) requested; batch 2 NPC idles (Creatures-64-001) arrived, review next

tasks.title: Snowy northern Fishing island
tasks.detail: Owner pick vp_fishing: snow props and ice at the pond edge, on purpose. Needs an art request (art director) and integration once delivered.
tasks.blockedBy: Art request ART-SPEC 3.8 on Drive since 2026-10-21, waiting on the artist. On delivery, code hooks: ice edge along the pond curve, ice floes, per-biome snow lip, snow trees/props on Fishing, fix_spring_snow, snowfall overlay

tasks.title: UI QA: batch B review
tasks.detail: UI QA pass of visual pass batch B (anchored panels, Pixelify Sans, icon bar + menu, crisp zoom). Findings in docs/reviews/2026-10-21-ui-qa-batch-b.md.

tasks.title: UI QA fixes after batch B
tasks.detail: From docs/reviews/2026-10-21-ui-qa-batch-b.md: Stats doesn't fit phone safe area (#3), Stats Flow overlap at 720p (#4), Altar tree crowding (#5), world pill / NEW badge text under 12 px (#7), phone panels shrink below the text floor (#10), narrow quest panel at 720p (#11), off-screen anchored panels (#8).

tasks.title: Pixel font readability: 5 reads as S, 3 as 8, B as 8
tasks.detail: Owner 2026-10-22: Menu > Settings 'Text font' (Pixelify only, Pixelify titles + Jersey 10 [default], Jersey 10 only, VT323, Press Start 2P, Smooth).

milestones.name: Art coverage
milestones.goal: Make sure everything the player sees has real art, not placeholders or emoji.
milestones.exit: No emoji icons remain in the UI and every delivered art piece is used somewhere in the game.

tasks.title: All buildings, nodes, items and creatures have real art
tasks.detail: Every building, resource, item and enemy uses delivered pixel art.

tasks.title: UI chrome: panels, buttons, cards, bars, cursor
tasks.detail: The interface uses the delivered jade/lacquer frames, buttons and cursors.

tasks.title: Replace emoji icons in the UI with real icons
tasks.detail: Perk, upgrade, quest and toolbar icons were delivered but the UI still draws emoji.

tasks.title: Use the 10 delivered pieces that have no place yet
tasks.detail: Dragon stirring, meditating disciple, small glyphs, veil edge, waterfall pieces.

milestones.name: Builds and tech health
milestones.goal: Keep the project healthy to build and store: Windows and WebGL builds that work, and a scene file small enough for GitHub.
milestones.exit: Fresh Windows and WebGL builds show the new island look, and no file in the repository exceeds GitHub's limit.

tasks.title: Windows and WebGL builds
tasks.detail: One-click builds; browser saves fixed so progress survives a reload.

tasks.title: Rebuild Windows + WebGL with the new island look
tasks.detail: Current builds predate the cliff walls and cloud sea.

tasks.title: Keep the scene file under GitHub's 100 MB limit
tasks.detail: Picked 'Yes, move it out' (2026-10-12): generated island layers become separate asset files in the repo (still on GitHub), so Game.unity shrinks well below the 100 MB limit.

milestones.name: Agent team and background copy
milestones.goal: Agents work like a small studio: permanent designer roles with their own guide documents, and all agent work happens in a background copy of the project so the owner's open Unity editor is never touched.
milestones.exit: 11 role agents defined with guide docs; a background worktree + headless Unity runs imports, rebuilds, screenshots and tests; CLAUDE.md rules updated; one real task done end to end through the background copy.

tasks.title: Define the 11 role agents and their guide documents
tasks.detail: World, Balance, Onboarding, UI/UX, UI QA, Art director, In-game art reviewer, Writer, Playtester, Performance, Code health — each an agent definition with a guide doc it owns.

tasks.title: Background copy: git worktree + headless Unity for all agent work
tasks.detail: A second copy of the project where agents import, rebuild, take screenshots and run tests without touching your open editor; results arrive via git.

milestones.name: Android build
milestones.goal: The game runs and plays well on an Android phone in landscape, with touch controls, and the owner gets an APK to test.
milestones.exit: Touch controls cover every mouse action; UI readable on a phone; landscape locked; full test gate green; APK built and tested (emulator or device); owner confirms on his phone.

tasks.title: Touch controls, phone UI, landscape, Android build
tasks.detail: Merged 2026-10-13: tap/hold/long-press feed, Give + Swap buttons, drag pan, pinch zoom, drag-ghost placement with Place/Cancel, tap-linger tooltips, Back menu; safe area, dpi canvas scale, 48dp hit areas; landscape lock; APK 51 MB. Touch PlayMode tests 15/15.

tasks.title: Run the APK on an Android emulator
tasks.detail: Install the Android emulator + a system image (large download from Google) to test the APK before you do.
tasks.blockedBy: Not possible here: Unity 6.3 builds Android for ARM64 only and the x86 emulator's ARM translation crashes in Unity's engine library during loading. Needs a real phone.

tasks.title: Owner tests the APK on his phone
tasks.detail: 2026-10-13: runs on the owner's phone. Feedback: Menu overflows, bottom bar crowded/clipped, desktop control words in quest/help text, Swap/Give buttons unstyled, wants a fresh start with no buildings (screenshots in docs/Design/feedback/phone-2026-10-13-*).

tasks.title: Phone fixes round 1 + new game with no buildings
tasks.detail: Merged 2026-10-13: Menu fits (jade, 3-column), compact phone bar (Stats/Build/Demolish/Menu), touch wording (ControlWords), styled Swap/Give, New game starts with NO buildings (bot: 2:33 human pace, auto/hand 3.8x mid-run - below the 5x target).

tasks.title: Owner tests APK round 2
tasks.detail: Check the Menu, bar, touch wording, Swap/Give and New game on the phone; quest panel looked semi-transparent in captures - confirm on device.
